items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent inventory sprite for an existing game. Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE existing item sheet: faithfully match its almost-black thick round outlines, chunky toy-like proportions, warm brown wood, light gray steel, simple broad two-tone fills and minimal detail. Image 2 is the crossbow to REDRAW; its detailed metal facets and realistic construction are WRONG. Recreate a crossbow as if the exact artist of image 1 drew a seventeenth icon for that sheet. Use the sword, axe and bow in image 1 as the guide. Compact chubby crossbow with a broad simple bow and short thick wooden stock, diagonal lower-left to upper-right. ONE dark outline around every outer shape; no dark metallic rendering, no tiny bolts, no thin line highlights, no etched grooves, no wood grain, no white sticker outline, no dramatic perspective. At most one flat shade patch per material. It must look equally simple and equally chunky next to the old axe. One centered icon, 10% clear margin, true transparent alpha background (do NOT copy the checkerboard from image 1), no text or shadow.

Use case: precise-object-edit plus style matching. Image 1 is the approved existing game's sword icon and defines the bold dark outline, light gray steel and simple two-tone shading style. Image 2 is a mace revision: keep the warm brown short thick handle and thick black outline, but REPLACE ITS ENTIRE AXE-LIKE HEAD with an unmistakable ROUND BALL MACE HEAD. A roughly circular gray iron ball with exactly three short chunky triangular studs sticking out at the top and sides, only one broad light-gray crescent highlight. The head must be a round heavy knob, NOT an axe blade, NOT a leaf, NOT a spearhead. The result is a short chubby spiked mace diagonally upward to the right. Same simple cartoon game icon style as image 1, no realistic metallic facets, no scratches, no small rivets, no white border. One item centered, 10% margin, transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no text, no ground shadow.
